root_cause.summary: The live Gateway process remained present and used little CPU while its event loop lost about 17 seconds. Independent host sampling found the shared developer Mac saturated by unrelated development/UI/VM work, with zero idle CPU in the worst sample, load around 42 and very high disk traffic. Relay freshness recovery then amplified the stall. This is not evidence of a DVR authentication, shared-session, socket or process-crash failure.
root_cause.qualification_boundary: The failed run did not yet record host telemetry in each checkpoint, so it remains failed Product qualification evidence and cannot be reclassified as PASS. The successor monitor records and gates host interference explicitly.
